# #7484: every enumerated spelling-gate leaf and the bucket it lands in.
#
# SITE LIST, not counts (#9094 / #8921). The three numbers in
# TestSchemaSpellingGateCoverageIsGated_7484 are the ratchet; this is the
# diagnostic they never had. A count cannot see a SUBSTITUTION — a leaf
# moving between two blind classes holds every total steady while the thing
# each ceiling describes has changed completely.
#
# Regenerate: UPDATE_7484=1 go test ./pkg/config/ -run TestSpellingGateMembersAreRecorded7484
# Never run it to make a failure go away — read the named arrivals first.
#
